name: unity-dev
description: Decision discipline for ALL of Unity game development — bootstrapping a project from scratch, adding systems and features, C# gameplay/UI/data code, bug fixes, content and level work, refactoring, optimization, and phase transitions. Provides a cost model, hook-enforced preflight/postflight gates that hold inside subagents too, and four self-auditing maps (index, codemap, unitymap, assetmap) with a fixed locate order, so a task never scans the repo. Requires bash, python3 and Claude Code v2.1.195+ (macOS, Linux, or Windows via WSL).
